findings.name: Opera
findings.summary: Opera Norway AS is a multinational technology corporation headquartered in Oslo, Norway, with additional offices in Europe, China, and Africa. Opera offers a range of products and services that include PC and mobile web browsers, GameMaker and gaming portals, the Opera News content recommendation products, the Opera Ads platform, and a number of Web3 and e-commerce products and services. Opera is noted for browser innovation and its early adoption of technologies such as artificial intelligence (AI), cryptocurrency, and Web3. The company has 296 million monthly active users.
